name: an active announce with no hops
an ANNOUNCE_START carries its cost and the retired second field at the ceiling
an ANNOUNCE_END retracts by id
a body too short for its fields is malformed, not a wait for more (fuzz regression)
a lite-06 body too short for its path is malformed, not a wait for more (fuzz regression)
a lite-07 body too short for its path base is malformed, not a wait for more (fuzz regression)
a ROUTE carries a path of hops, each a Node ID, its Start, and a session, then flags, priority, and cost
a ROUTE's 0x2 flag marks a path through a draining node
a ROUTE flag no version defines is refused
a ROUTE with more than 32 hops is refused
a ROUTE with no hops is refused
a ROUTE missing a hop it counts is refused
a ROUTE hop naming Node ID 0 is refused
a ROUTE_END references its Route ID
a DEAD names the hop whose session closed and the node at its far end
a DEAD naming Far Node ID 0 is refused
a DRAIN names the node that sent GOAWAY
a DRAIN naming Node ID 0 is refused
an ANNOUNCE_REQUEST continues its edit, removes Prefix IDs, and adds prefixes, each with its Hidden
an ANNOUNCE_REQUEST ending its edit may be empty
an ANNOUNCE_REQUEST whose More is neither 0 nor 1 is refused
an ANNOUNCE_REQUEST whose Hidden is neither 0 nor 1 is refused
an ANNOUNCE_OK is empty
a SYNCED names its Prefix ID
an ANNOUNCE_FLOOR names its Route ID and the Revision its batch is complete as of
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START names its instance, epoch, cost, how far above it was claimed, flags, priority, and the relays it crossed
a claim's 0x1 flag says no route reaches it, and its 0x2 flag that a node on the way is draining
a claim flag no version defines is refused
a claim whose chain names Node ID 0 is refused
a claim whose chain names more than 32 relays is refused
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START with an invalid path is refused
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START with an invalid instance is refused
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_START cut short is refused
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_UPDATE references its announce id and carries the claim as it now stands
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_END says its publisher withdrew the claim
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_END with Lost says only the sender's way to the claim is gone
a lite-07 ANNOUNCE_END whose Lost is neither 0 nor 1 is refused
an ANNOUNCE_INIT within the announce budget
an ANNOUNCE_INIT listing more broadcasts than the budget is refused before its paths decode
an ANNOUNCE_INIT one byte past one storage segment is refused at its length prefix
a group sequence at 2^62-1, the largest a QUIC varint holds
a group sequence at 2^64-1, the largest a u64 holds
a lite-07 group carrying a Frame Start, which only lite-06 has
a group naming the start just below it as the previous one, carried plus one
a server pinned to a version the client offered selects it
a server pinned to a version the client did not offer refuses
